2022, Amazon conducted a comprehensive analysis to inform
the sustainability topics that are relevant to our reporting.
To guide our analysis, we leveraged Datamaran, a business
intelligence platform, referencing data-driven insights from
leading reporting frameworks, including the Sustainability
Accounting Standards Board (SASB), the Task Force on
Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), and the
Global Reporting Initiative (GRI). The platform also
analyzed the regulatory landscape, media, and company
reports to inform the topics. We also consulted with key
stakeholders, including internal decision-makers, employees,
partner organizations, nongovernmental organizations,
and academics, to capture their input and broad range
of perspectives.
